question_text: A 72-year-old man comes to the physician with chills, nausea, and diffuse muscle aches for 3 days. His niece had similar symptoms 2 weeks ago and H1N1 influenza strain was isolated from her respiratory secretions. He received his influenza vaccination 2 months ago. His temperature is 38°C (100.4°F). A rapid influenza test is positive. Which of the following mechanisms best explains this patient's infection despite vaccination?
